title: A scene from my paranormal visual novel Rina Darkly
author: soulglider26
selftext:
I posted an initial teaser previously, so here's some more shots of the gameplay

You play as Rina Darkly, a paranormal investigator. You uncover a larger plot and danger threatening the world and race to solve the mystery. It's 80% story mystery puzzle.

Scenes like these are like mini-episodes, but they all string together for a larger plot. There are multiple endings, different paths you can take, and you can fail missions causing companion deaths. Your main ability is the ability to interact with other world energy.

None of what you see above is AI video generation. I actually abandoned that for individual images (Chatgpt Imagegen) to build sprites, and code driven transitions and animations. I may mix in some AI video scenes as well, but this process seems to have significantly more control over scenes, setups, and consistency.

This is heavily inspired by a mix of western film like The Conjuring, Constantine, Evil and more. And then 2000s anime, in particular Mnemosyne, Noir, Higurashi no Naku Koro ni.

One thing that's helped a ton in this process of making this so far (far from done of course) is spending a LOT of time with animation research and testing. I have hundreds of short clips from various anime I'm using as study, and then test techniques to accomplish similar animations
